row.label: game mode
row.help: video mode is the engine's own r_mode list (its 33 modes, then auto and custom); applying restarts the level at that mode. field of view stops at 90 because this build draws no view weapon above it (measured: 91° and up drops the gun). The engine's custom ui scale and the 91–120° field-of-view range are not offered; see docs/presentation-fixes.md. game mode (Alt+Enter while the game has the keyboard) is this page's native-game presentation: the game surface alone, every page control hidden, and the page black outside the picture. It asks for full screen on the display the game is on; on a desktop it allows the Window Management API it also blacks out each additional display. Esc leaves full screen and the mode. It is not the engine's own fullscreen row above, which the engine applies on its next start.
